english: Hi! Sorry to keep you waiting!\pWelcome to the world of POKéMON!\pMy name is BIRCH.\pBut everyone calls me the POKéMON\nPROFESSOR.\p
dutch: Hoi! Sorry dat je moest wachten!\pWelkom in de wereld van POKéMON!\pMijn naam is BIRCH.\pMaar iedereen noemt mij de\nPOKéMON-PROFESSOR.\p

english: This is what we call a “POKéMON.”\p\n

This world is widely inhabited by
creatures known as POKéMON.\pWe humans live alongside POKéMON,
at times as friendly playmates, and\lat times as cooperative workmates.\pAnd sometimes, we band together
and battle others like us.\pBut despite our closeness, we don't
know everything about POKéMON.\pIn fact, there are many, many
secrets surrounding POKéMON.\pTo unravel POKéMON mysteries,
I've been undertaking research.\lThat's what I do.\p
dutch:
Deze wereld wordt bewoond door
wezens die POKéMON heten.\pWij mensen leven samen met POKéMON.
Soms spelen we samen.\lSoms werken we samen.\pEn soms vechten we samen
tegen andere TRAINERS.\pToch weten we nog lang
niet alles over POKéMON.\pEr zijn nog heel veel
geheimen.\pIk zoek uit hoe die geheimen
zitten. Dat is mijn werk.\p
